package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_did.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Group-time ATT with att_gt and aggregation
limitation: No anticipation, group-specific parallel trends and comparison support
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Unit/time identifiers, outcome, first-adoption cohort, comparison group, covariates and weighting/sampling design.
scientific_qualification.output: ATT(g,t), influence functions and selected pointwise/uniform inference; aggregation requires appropriate retained influence information.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: No anticipation, conditional group-specific parallel trends, comparison support and correct panel/repeated-cross-section interpretation.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Pinned att_gt allows at most one additional coarser cluster beyond individual ID. Uniform bands require bootstrap. compute_inffunc=False disables inference/pretests/bands and prevents aggte. Inspect fixed-weight anchor rules before using unbalanced panels.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Reproduce known cohort effects and weighted aggregations; reject incompatible changing-treatment encodings and unsupported cluster layouts. Explicitly test the points-only path cannot be promoted to an interval.

evidence.finding: att_gt design, weights, clustering, inference and aggregation controls.

pinned_api_revision.scope: Inspected API files at this commit; not an assertion about all README bytes or the published package release.
